weaknesses: The abstract does not sufficiently clarify the implications of the Polyak–Łojasiewicz condition on the generality of the results.
The experimental section lacks a comprehensive comparison with existing methods to highlight the significance of the proposed approach.
Key assumptions regarding the initialization of weights are not explicitly stated in the abstract, which may mislead readers about the applicability of the results.
strengths: The paper provides a rigorous theoretical framework connecting deep residual networks and neural ODEs, contributing to the understanding of implicit regularization.
The use of numerical experiments effectively illustrates the theoretical findings, demonstrating the practical relevance of the results.
The paper addresses an important gap in the literature regarding the training dynamics of residual networks, offering valuable insights for future research.
